name: go-to-line
author: lumine-code
description: Show the cursor position and jump to lines or ranges.
backgroundTips: You can jump straight to lines or ranges with {{ 'go-to-line:toggle' | keystroke }}
The status bar shows the cursor position and selection size; click it to open Go to Line.

showInStatusBar.title: Show In Status Bar
showInStatusBar.description: Show the cursor position of the active text editor in the status bar.

statusBarTemplate.title: Status Bar Template
statusBarTemplate.description: Select the information shown in the cursor position tile. Choose `Custom` to use the template below.
enum: Row and Column, Lines and Chars
statusBarTemplate.default: Row and Column, Lines and Chars

customStatusBarTemplate.title: Custom Status Bar Template
customStatusBarTemplate.description: Liquid template used when `Status Bar Template` is `Custom`. Variables: `start.row`, `start.col` (where the selection begins, or the cursor when nothing is selected), `end.row`, `end.col` (where the cursor is; equals `start` with no selection), `lines`, `chars` (selected line and character counts), and `n` (number of cursors). `start` and `end` follow the selection's direction.
customStatusBarTemplate.default: {{ start.row }}:{{ start.col }}{% if chars %}-{{ end.row }}:{{ end.col }}{% endif %}{% if n > 1 %} #{{ n }}{% endif %}
